categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在 Agent 的工具生成与 RL 增益归因、多模态空间与医学影像理解，以及模型不确定性的可控表达。

articles.title: Language Models Steer on Injected Uncertainty Tokens, but Fail to Self-Monitor In Situ
articles.zh: 语言模型能依据注入的不确定性 token 进行引导，但无法在原位自我监控
articles.summary: 如果你打算靠让模型"自己报告不确定性"来做安全兜底，这篇说明外部注入的不确定性信号能被模型利用，但它对自己内部状态的实时监控并不可靠
articles.author: Daniel Theron
articles.body: Prompting language models to verbalize stepwise numerical confidence during generation is an increasingly popular approach for triggering backtracking and error correction in agentic reasoning. This strategy presupposes two capabilities: (1) in-situ monitoring fidelity (does confidence drop when an error occurs?) and (2) downstream steering control (does an uncertainty token causally steer the model to repair its error?). We evaluated four open-weights models (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B, and Phi-4, 14.7B) across 15,200 math benchmark attempts, isolating 2,017 reasoning errors within each model's capability frontier. Applying 27,568 counterfactual continuations across these failure points, we demonstrate a consistent decoupling between monitoring and control. On monitoring, all four models fail to detect their own errors. Verbalized confidence does not distinguish mistake steps from sound reasoning, yielding near-chance within-position AUROCs between 0.500 and 0.561. Even at a model's first reasoning error, trajectory confidence remains saturated at 95.1% to 99.9%, with noticeable drops ($\ge 10$ points) appearing on fewer than 9% of errors in Llama and under 1.6% in the other three models. In contrast, models respond readily to external uncertainty: injecting a low-confidence tag (10%) at the error step significantly increases downstream correction across all models (+3.7 to +22.5 points over format-matched 95% certainty; all $p \le 0.0022$), reaching up to 38.5% under active rethinking instructions. However, injecting doubt onto already-correct steps causes models to discard valid reasoning, reducing solve rates by up to 22.8 points. Inference-time self-correction is thus bottlenecked by in-situ error detection rather than downstream repair capacity: models readily steer toward recovery when prompted with doubt, yet fail to self-monitor during generation.
articles.bodyZh: 现在越来越流行的一种做法，是让语言模型在生成的时候，把每一步的数值置信度说出来，好触发智能体推理（agentic reasoning）里的回溯和纠错。这套策略其实预设了两个能力：第一，现场监控保真度（in-situ monitoring fidelity）——出错的时候置信度会不会掉？第二，下游引导控制（downstream steering control）——一个不确定性标记能不能因果性地引导模型去修复错误？我们评估了四个开放权重模型（open-weights models）：Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B和Phi-4（14.7B），一共跑了15200次数学基准测试，在每个模型的能力边界内隔离出2017个推理错误。然后在这些失败点上做了27568次反事实续写（counterfactual continuations），结果发现监控和控制之间一直存在脱节。监控方面，四个模型都检测不出自己的错误。口头置信度（verbalized confidence）分不清错误步骤和正确推理，同一位置内的AUROC（曲线下面积）只有0.500到0.561，几乎等于瞎猜。就算到了模型犯的第一个推理错误，整条轨迹的置信度仍然饱和在95.1%到99.9%；在Llama里，只有不到9%的错误会出现明显下降（至少10个点），其他三个模型更是不到1.6%。反过来，模型对外部的不确定性倒是很买账：在出错的那一步注入一个低置信度标签（10%），所有模型的下游纠错都显著增加（比格式匹配的95%确定性高3.7到22.5个点；所有p ≤ 0.0022），在主动重新思考指令（active rethinking instructions）下最高能到38.5%。但是，如果往本来正确的步骤上注入怀疑，模型就会把有效推理扔掉，解题率最多下降22.8个点。所以，推理时自我纠错（inference-time self-correction）的瓶颈不在下游修复能力，而在于现场错误检测（in-situ error detection）：只要提示里有怀疑，模型很容易被引导去恢复；可它在生成过程中就是没法自我监控。

articles.title: CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans
articles.zh: CTLink：将放射报告发现与 3D 胸部 CT 扫描关联的文本提示分割模型
articles.summary: 如果你在做影像报告与 3D 影像的病灶对应（自动勾画、随访比对），这个文本提示分割的建模思路可以直接借鉴
articles.author: Mohammed Baharoon, Sung Eun Kim 等
articles.body: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to. We introduce CTLink, a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that segments findings described in a chest CT report. CTLink was trained on 4123 noncontrast chest CT scans with 9547 segmented report findings, including ReXGroundingCTv2, a newly annotated dataset of 1134 scans and 1895 findings with every instance of each finding segmented. On the 200 ReXGroundingCT validation scans, CTLink achieved a hit rate of 0.816, an instance F1 score of 0.456, and a mean Dice score of 0.400, compared with 0.533, 0.175, and 0.234 for VoxTell, a publicly available text-prompted segmentation model (P < .001 for all). On the test set of the MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding challenge, an ensemble of seven CTLink models achieved the highest hit rate (0.782) and instance F1 score (0.386) of all 48 participating teams. On 50 test scans segmented twice by independent radiologists, CTLink matched or exceeded inter-rater agreement. Diffuse non-focal findings remained the main limitation, partly because their extent is outlined inconsistently even between radiologists. The CTLink model weights are available at https://huggingface.co/rajpurkarlab/CTLink, and the dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/rajpurkarlab/ReXGroundingCT.
articles.bodyZh:
放射科报告只用文字描述看到的发现，并不会在影像上把对应的位置标出来，所以看报告的人没法直接知道，报告里写的每一条发现到底指的是哪个异常。

为此我们推出了 CTLink，这是一个文本提示（text-prompted）的三维分割（3D segmentation）模型，能把胸部 CT 报告里描述的那些发现，在影像上分割出来。

训练 CTLink 用的是 4123 例平扫胸部 CT（noncontrast chest CT），对应报告里的 9547 条已分割发现；这其中包括新标注的数据集 ReXGroundingCTv2——1134 例扫描、1895 条发现，每条发现涉及的每个实例都做了分割标注。

在 ReXGroundingCT 的 200 例验证扫描上，CTLink 的命中率（hit rate）是 0.816，实例 F1 分数（instance F1 score）是 0.456，平均 Dice 分数（Dice score）是 0.400；作为对比，公开可用的文本提示分割模型 VoxTell 这三项分别是 0.533、0.175 和 0.234（三项比较的 P 值都小于 .001）。

在 MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding 挑战赛的测试集上，把七个 CTLink 模型集成（ensemble）起来使用，命中率（0.782）和实例 F1 分数（0.386）在全部 48 支参赛队伍里都是最高的。

另外，在 50 例由不同放射科医生各自分割了两次的测试扫描上，CTLink 的表现已经达到、甚至超过了医生之间的一致性（inter-rater agreement）。

目前最主要的短板，还是那些弥漫性、没有明确病灶中心的发现（diffuse non-focal findings）；部分原因是，这类病变的范围即使在放射科医生之间也勾画得不一致。

CTLink 的模型权重已经公开，地址是 https://huggingface.co/rajpurkarlab/CTLink；数据集在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/rajpurkarlab/ReXGroundingCT。

articles.title: Seeking in Space: Benchmarking Purposeful Active Exploration of Vision-Language Models for Spatial Reasoning
articles.zh: 在空间中寻求：评测视觉语言模型面向空间推理的有目的主动探索能力
articles.summary: 如果你以为 VLM 已经"懂空间"，这个 benchmark 会告诉你它们主动去探查、去找信息的本事还差得远
articles.author: Xiwei Liu, Yulong Li 等
articles.body: Humans explore unfamiliar spaces with purpose, deciding where to look until they have gathered the evidence a spatial question requires. However, can vision-language models (VLMs), which reason increasingly well over curated images and videos, also seek in space when the evidence is not handed to them? We present ActSpace-Bench, a benchmark of 994 questions across 234 exploration episodes in 72 real-scanned indoor scenes, where a model starts from a single view, navigates real captured frames, and must gather evidence before answering. To assess whether such exploration is purposeful, we introduce a controlled evaluation protocol that fixes each model as the reasoner and compares its own exploration against a same-budget random walk and an oracle route, separating evidence seeking from spatial reasoning. Every question is verified to require exploration and answered from 3D annotations, masked-evidence questions test whether models know when to abstain, and over 95% of sampled questions are confirmed correct by human verification. Evaluations of 23 proprietary, open-weight, and spatially specialized VLMs reveal that the strongest models do seek evidence with purpose but lose much of it to limited memory, whereas weaker and specialized models explore no better than a random walk or fail to reason over the evidence they are given, pointing to memory and evidence-grounded reasoning as the next targets for active spatial intelligence.
articles.bodyZh: 人类在探索陌生空间时，是有目的地在决定往哪看，直到收集到回答某个空间问题所需的证据。但问题是，视觉语言模型（vision-language models, VLMs）虽然在整理好的图片和视频上越来越会推理，当证据没有直接送到眼前时，它们能不能也在空间里主动去找？我们推出了 ActSpace-Bench，这是一个基准测试（benchmark），包含 72 个真实扫描的室内场景、234 段探索过程里的 994 道题；模型从单一视角出发，在真实拍摄的画面帧之间导航，必须先收集证据再回答。为了判断这种探索到底是不是有目的的，我们设计了一套受控评测协议：把每个模型固定为推理器（reasoner），拿它自己的探索过程，和同样预算的随机游走（random walk）以及神谕路线（oracle route）作比较，从而把“找证据”和“空间推理”分开。每道题都经过确认：必须探索才能回答，答案来自 3D 标注；遮蔽证据题（masked-evidence questions）用来测试模型知不知道什么时候该弃答（abstain）；抽样题目中超过 95% 经人工核验确认正确。对 23 个闭源（proprietary）、开放权重（open-weight）和空间专用（spatially specialized）VLM 的评测显示：最强的模型确实会有目的地找证据，但很大一部分能力被有限的记忆拖累了；而较弱和专用模型要么探索得并不比随机游走更好，要么即使拿到证据也推理不出来。这说明，下一步要攻的是记忆和基于证据的推理，这也是主动空间智能（active spatial intelligence）的关键目标。

articles.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
articles.zh: ToolSmith：面向多模态搜索 Agent 的自动工具生成框架
articles.summary: 如果你在搭多模态检索 Agent 却卡在工具得一个个手写，这套自动生成工具的思路能省下大量工程量，代价是多了一层生成质量的不确定性
articles.author: Rui Sun, Junhua Huang 等
articles.body: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. However, the library is laborious to create and maintain, and frozen when new query types, evidence formats, and failure modes are encountered in the wild. Human practitioners, by contrast, cope with insufficient tools by fashioning new ones from familiar parts and reusing them across tasks. Inspired by this, we propose ToolSmith, an automatic tool-generation framework that grows and reuses modules on top of a lean base tool library. We evaluate ToolSmith on three in-domain multimodal search benchmarks and ten out-of-domain benchmarks under a VLM-as-a-Judge protocol. ToolSmith consistently improves over the base library across deployed agents of varying scales, with larger backbones reaping greater gains, demonstrating the scalability of the approach. Our code and data are available at https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/.
articles.bodyZh: 最近的多模态搜索智能体（multimodal search agents）会靠多轮推理、视觉理解和实时联网搜索，调度一小套手工打造的搜索与视觉工具，来回答那些超出参数化知识（parametric knowledge）范围的问题。但这套工具库做起来费劲、维护起来也费劲，一旦在真实场景里碰上新的查询类型（query types）、证据格式（evidence formats）和失败模式（failure modes），它就直接卡住了，没法应对。相比之下，人类从业者遇到工具不够用，会拿熟悉的零件现拼新工具，还能在不同任务之间反复复用。受这个启发，我们提出了 ToolSmith，一个自动工具生成框架（automatic tool-generation framework），能在精简的基础工具库（lean base tool library）之上不断长出并复用模块。我们在三个域内（in-domain）多模态搜索基准（benchmarks）和十个域外（out-of-domain）基准上评估 ToolSmith，采用的是 VLM-as-a-Judge 协议。结果发现，在不同规模的已部署智能体（deployed agents）上，ToolSmith 都稳定胜过基础工具库；而且骨干模型（backbones）越大，收益越明显，说明这套方法有不错的可扩展性（scalability）。我们的代码和数据在 https://threesr.github.io/toolsmith/。

articles.title: Learning Neurovascular Codes for EEG-to-fMRI Synthesis
articles.zh: 面向 EEG 到 fMRI 合成的神经血管编码学习
articles.summary: 如果你想用便宜的 EEG 逼近 fMRI 才能拿到的信息，这篇给了一条基于神经血管耦合的建模路径，但别指望它真能替代 fMRI
articles.author: Yiming Sun, Yifan Wang 等
articles.body: In this paper, we introduce Neurovascular Codes as shared EEG representations for fMRI generation. We first train a separate EEG encoder to predict each fMRI signal, learning target-specific temporal and spectral features from the same EEG window. After training, we freeze the encoders and project their concatenated hidden features into a shared neurovascular code. Conditioned on this code, stochastic interpolant transforms Gaussian noise into a vector of fMRI signals, allowing different responses to be sampled for the same EEG window. We evaluate our approach on eight public simultaneous EEG-fMRI datasets, including four resting-state and four task-based datasets with 61,646 volume-level pairs. Under within-subject and held-out-subject evaluation, our model improves average Pearson correlation over the strongest encoder baselines by 19.1% and 19.8%, respectively. The corresponding improvements over the strongest generator baselines are 18.8% and 47.9%. Beyond reconstruction accuracy, we also evaluate the generated signals using subject-identification classifiers trained on real fMRI. Our method achieves the highest mean accuracy among the evaluated generators. We hope that our work opens up new opportunities for cross-modal brain modeling.
articles.bodyZh: 在这篇论文里，我们提出“神经血管编码”（Neurovascular Codes），把它当作一种共享的脑电（EEG）表示，用来生成功能磁共振（fMRI）信号。我们首先分别训练一个独立的脑电编码器（EEG encoder），去预测每一个fMRI信号，让它从同一段EEG时间窗里学到针对特定目标的时间特征（temporal features）和频谱特征（spectral features）。训练完之后，我们把这些编码器冻结住，再把它们拼接后的隐藏特征（concatenated hidden features）投影成一个共享的神经血管编码。以这个编码为条件，随机插值器（stochastic interpolant）会把高斯噪声（Gaussian noise）转换成一串fMRI信号向量，这样同一段EEG时间窗就能采样出不同的响应。我们在八个公开的同步EEG-fMRI数据集上做了评估，其中包括四个静息态数据集和四个任务态数据集，一共61,646个体数据级配对（volume-level pairs）。在被试内评估（within-subject evaluation）和留出被试评估（held-out-subject evaluation）这两种设置下，我们的模型相比最强的编码器基线（encoder baselines），平均皮尔逊相关系数（Pearson correlation）分别提升了19.1%和19.8%。相比最强的生成器基线（generator baselines），对应的提升分别是18.8%和47.9%。除了重建准确率，我们还用基于真实fMRI训练出来的受试者身份识别分类器（subject-identification classifiers）来评估生成信号。在参与评估的生成器里，我们的方法平均准确率最高。我们希望这项工作能为跨模态大脑建模（cross-modal brain modeling）打开新的机会。

articles.title: Know When to Abstain: Conformal Confidence Estimation for Text-to-SQL
articles.zh: 知道何时弃答：Text-to-SQL 的 conformal 置信度估计
articles.summary: 如果你把 Text-to-SQL 直接接到生产库上跑，这套带校准的弃答机制能给你一个"这题我不确定"的刹车
articles.author: Avinash Kumar Singh, Bhaskarjit Sarmah 等
articles.body: Text-to-SQL systems often return queries that execute successfully but answer the wrong question. Detecting these errors at deployment is hard because execution correctness is defined against a gold query, which exists only in labeled data. We formulate confidence estimation for Text-to-SQL as probabilistic query validation under a latent correctness variable that is observable at calibration time through gold-SQL execution and latent at deployment. Our estimator separates generation from validation. A generator LLM writes and executes the query, and a different critic LLM judges the query and its execution result. The critic's validation and execution-grounded alignment scores are fused with the generator's verbalized confidence, token-level uncertainty, and SQL-structural features in a Random Forest, using two sequential LLM calls. Two calibration steps give finite-sample guarantees. A Learn-then-Test threshold ensures, with probability $1-δ$, that the error rate among accepted queries stays below a user-chosen budget. A conformal p-value bounds the false abstention rate. On Spider we use GPT-OSS-120B as generator and Gemma-4-31B as critic. The estimator obtains an AUARC of 0.899. Without abstention, 22.6% of queries are wrong. With a 15% risk budget ($δ=0.1$), a threshold is certified on all 10 resampled splits, and the system accepts 52.4% of queries on average with 9.1% observed error. Five different critic models give similar results. In a controlled comparison on Spider with Olmo-3-32B as generator, the estimator obtains an AUARC of 89.5, compared with 81.2 for the strongest logit-based baseline. Applied to BIRD without retraining, the confidence scores remain informative (AUROC 0.72, against 0.79 on Spider), but the risk guarantee does not transfer, as expected without exchangeability.
articles.bodyZh: Text-to-SQL 系统经常返回的查询能跑通，但答的不是你要问的问题。这类错误在上线部署时很难发现，因为“执行对不对”是拿一条金标准查询（gold query）来判定的，而金标准只存在于有标注的数据里。我们把 Text-to-SQL 的置信度估计（confidence estimation）定义成一个概率式查询验证（probabilistic query validation）问题：背后有一个潜在的正确性变量（latent correctness variable），在校准阶段（calibration time）可以通过执行金标准 SQL（gold-SQL execution）观察到，但到部署阶段（deployment）就看不见了。我们的估计器把“生成”和“验证”分开：一个生成器大语言模型（generator LLM）负责写查询并执行，另一个不同的评审器大语言模型（critic LLM）负责判断这条查询和它的执行结果。评审器的验证分数和基于执行结果的对齐分数（execution-grounded alignment scores），会和生成器的语言化置信度（verbalized confidence）、token 级不确定性（token-level uncertainty）以及 SQL 结构特征（SQL-structural features）一起，在随机森林（Random Forest）里融合，整个过程用两次串行的 LLM 调用。两个校准步骤给出有限样本保证（finite-sample guarantees）：一个 Learn-then-Test 阈值能保证，以 1-δ 的概率，被接受查询里的错误率低于用户设定的预算。一个共形 p 值（conformal p-value）则给误弃答率（false abstention rate）设上界。在 Spider 上，我们用 GPT-OSS-120B 当生成器、Gemma-4-31B 当评审器，估计器拿到 0.899 的 AUARC。不做弃答时，22.6% 的查询是错的；在 15% 的风险预算（risk budget，δ=0.1）下，阈值在全部 10 个重采样切分（resampled splits）上都通过了认证，系统平均接受 52.4% 的查询，实测错误率 9.1%。换五个不同的评审器模型，结果也差不多。在 Spider 上做一个受控对比，用 Olmo-3-32B 当生成器，估计器拿到 89.5 的 AUARC，而最强的基于 logit 的基线（logit-based baseline）是 81.2。把它不重新训练直接用到 BIRD 上，置信度分数仍然有信息量（AUROC 0.72，在 Spider 上是 0.79），但风险保证没法跟着迁移过去——在没有可交换性（exchangeability）的情况下，这也是意料之中。

articles.title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
articles.zh: CO-GRAFT：通过角色级策略嫁接归因搜索 Agent 中的强化学习增益
articles.summary: 如果你在做搜索 Agent 的 RL 训练却说不清涨点到底来自哪一步，这套角色级策略嫁接能把功劳拆开算
articles.author: Ramraj Chandradevan, Sayontan Ghosh 等
articles.body: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.
articles.bodyZh: 强化学习（RL）能让大语言模型搜索智能体（large language model search agents）在强化学习前的初始化模型基础上，最多提升32个精确匹配（EM）点；但光看总体准确率涨了多少，并不能告诉我们：训练过程中到底是哪些底层功能变强了，或者哪些功能之间产生了配合。我们提出了CO-GRAFT，一个不依赖奖励信号的干预式归因框架（reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework）：在这个框架里，一个经过RL训练的智能体和它RL前的初始化版本，会在带实时检索（live retrieval）的闭环执行（closed-loop execution）中，共同生成同一条轨迹。两个策略各自控制四个功能角色（functional roles）中互不重叠的一部分：中间推理（intermediate reasoning）、决定是搜索还是直接作答（search-or-answer decision）、生成搜索查询（search query generation）、抽取最终答案（final answer extraction）。在不改权重、不重新训练的情况下，把16种（2^4=16）角色分配全跑一遍，就定义了一个合作博弈（cooperative game）：它的沙普利值（Shapley values）能把RL带来的总收益拆到各个角色头上，而莫比乌斯交互项（Möbius interaction terms）则能区分某个角色单独变强，和多个角色之间相互配合带来的提升。我们把CO-GRAFT用到Search-R1智能体上，覆盖Qwen2.5和Llama-3.2模型（包括两种规模、base和指令微调初始化、GRPO和PPO优化器，以及NQ和HotpotQA数据集），结果发现：生成搜索查询这件事对总收益的贡献从没超过15%；真正左右收益的是RL前答案本身是否有效（answer validity）、搜索有没有被保留下来（search retention）、模型规模，以及固定的任务级搜索预算（fixed task-level search budgets）。在更大、或者答案响应格式更规整的检查点（answer response checkpoints）里，功劳会从推理转向答案抽取；而更小的base模型则更依赖推理和决策之间的耦合（reasoning--decision coupling）。

articles.title: Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions
articles.zh: Needwise：基于需求层级类型化决策的免生成对话推荐
articles.summary: 如果你嫌生成式对话推荐又慢又爱瞎编，这套免生成的类型化决策路线可能更稳也更便宜
articles.author: Sungchul Kim, Weixiao Huang 等
articles.body: Conversational recommenders must rank items against needs that catalogs record only in part, while users add, withdraw and reverse needs and switch between requests. LLM rankers re-read the dialogue at every turn: they are slow, and their ordering does not show which needs an item meets. We show that a conversational recommender can be built from typed decisions instead: named questions over fixed options, answered with option probabilities rather than generated text. On each turn, one typed request maps the message onto the catalog's fields, keeps what no field expresses in the user's words, and decides how the turn changes each earlier need. Needwise then ranks candidates must-first: the needs on the kind of item, its place and its price form a tier, and within it one holistic decision and need-level verdicts (supported, contradicted or unknown) are combined with equal weight (Needwise-HF). With the graded attributes withheld from the records, so that needs must be inferred from names, descriptions and reviews, Needwise-HF ranks Google Local requests significantly better than GPT-6 Sol (0.383 against 0.343 nDCG@10) and is not significantly different from the strongest LLM ranker on Google Local and Yelp; these comparisons keep their sign under every treatment of unrecorded attributes we test. It costs a fraction of GPT-6 Sol's API price and answers in 2.5 s at the median on Google Local, against 5.6 s for GPT-6 Sol. In conversations, the typed state keeps the ranking across switches and returns, but it recognizes only 19-27% of withdrawn needs.
articles.bodyZh: 对话式推荐系统（conversational recommenders）得在商品目录只记录了一部分需求的情况下，把商品和用户需求匹配起来；而用户会新增需求、撤回需求、把需求反过来，还会在不同请求之间来回切换。大语言模型排序器（LLM rankers）每一轮都要重新读一遍对话：速度慢，而且它们排出来的顺序也看不出某件商品到底满足了哪些需求。我们证明，可以改用类型化决策（typed decisions）来搭建对话式推荐系统：在固定选项上问有名字的问题，用选项概率（option probabilities）来回答，而不是让模型生成文本。每一轮里，一个类型化请求（typed request）会把用户消息映射到商品目录的字段上，把没有字段能表达的内容按用户原话保留下来，并判断这一轮会怎样改变前面每一个需求。然后 Needwise 按“必须项优先”给候选商品排序：对商品类型、地点和价格的需求构成一层，在这一层里，一个整体决策（holistic decision）和需求级判定（need-level verdicts，支持、矛盾或未知）以相同权重结合起来（Needwise-HF）。在把分级属性（graded attributes）从记录里拿掉、逼着系统只能从名称、描述和评论里推断需求时，Needwise-HF 在 Google Local 请求上的排序显著好于 GPT-6 Sol（nDCG@10 为 0.383，对 0.343），并且在 Google Local 和 Yelp 上与最强的 LLM 排序器没有显著差异；在我们测试的每一种未记录属性处理方式下，这些比较的正负方向都保持不变。它的成本只有 GPT-6 Sol API 价格的一小部分，在 Google Local 上响应时间中位数是 2.5 秒，而 GPT-6 Sol 是 5.6 秒。在对话中，类型化状态能在用户切换和返回时保持排序，但它只能识别 19% 到 27% 的撤回需求（withdrawn needs）。
